race.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
race.verdict: OPPENHEIMER has the air of one who could continue to improve for the James Owen yard and he can maintain his unbeaten start for his new trainer. Our Dagger and Titainium both arrive after promising efforts and can pose the main threats. OPPENHEIMER (IRE) OUR DAGGER (IRE) TITAINIUM
